findings.defect: Rendered opacity prevents inspection of interior geometry; source RGBA alpha is 0.18, so this is a presentation uncertainty, not an established geometry defect.
findings.evidence: Top: six opaque pale-blue roof panels hide craters, ramp and bucket. Front and iso: broad opaque panels similarly conceal the interior.
findings.part: clear PET canopy and side panels
findings.repair: Resolve faithful transparency or obtain explicitly identified targeted interior views, then inspect missing geometry before claiming visual pass.

observation: Front, top and iso were inspected once. Exterior framing, controls, feet and collection cup appear coherently placed, but nominally clear PET renders opaque and hides the playfield and jackpot; interior placement and required action cannot be assessed from these views.
